blogs.title: Why Angles Matter: The Secret Power of Neuron Orientation in Text‑to‑Image Diffusion
blogs.description: Dive into the surprising role of neuron directions—seen as points on a hypersphere—when adapting big diffusion models. Explain how keeping pairwise angles intact preserves the model’s rich semantic knowledge, and how a simple orthogonal tweak can shift styles or subjects without losing fidelity.

blogs.title: Orthogonal Finetuning Unpacked: A Hands‑On Guide for Adapting Diffusion Models
blogs.description: Walk readers through the mechanics of OFT: from the idea of rotating all neurons in a layer, to efficient Cayley parametrization and block‑diagonal tricks that make it lightweight. Include pseudo‑code snippets, intuition behind preserving hyperspherical energy, and tips for debugging stability.

blogs.title: From DreamBooth to OFT: A New Era for Subject‑Driven Image Generation
blogs.description: Compare traditional DreamBooth fine‑tuning with OFT on a few examples. Highlight how OFT’s orthogonal updates maintain subject identity, converge faster, and reduce the need for delicate learning‑rate tweaks—making personalized image generation simpler and more robust.

blogs.title: Controllable Generation Made Easy: How Orthogonal Finetuning Outshines ControlNet and T2I‑Adapter
blogs.description: Showcase OFT on edge‑to‑image, segmentation‑to‑image, and landmark‑to‑face tasks. Explain the newly introduced control consistency metric, discuss faster convergence with fewer parameters, and illustrate through side‑by‑side image comparisons why orthogonal tweaks deliver sharper control without extra inference cost.

blogs.title: Beyond Finetuning: Exploring Orthogonal Matrices for Compositional Generation
blogs.description: Speculate on a future where multiple task‐specific orthogonal transforms are chained together. Discuss potential benefits (compositionality, zero‑shot mashups) and challenges (maintaining overall performance), inspiring readers to experiment with matrix multiplication as a new augmentation technique.
